v0.1.0.description:
Community testing build. Feedback and bug reports welcome.

## Install

**1. BepInEx** — download **BepInEx 6 bleeding-edge, `Unity.Mono`, `win-x64`** from
<https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be> and unzip it into the game folder,
next to `Zoominoes.exe`. Zoominoes is a Unity 6 Mono game; BepInEx 5 will not work.
Run the game once so BepInEx creates its folders, then close it.

e.g. for Windows:
<https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be/785/BepInEx-Unity.Mono-win-x64-6.0.0-be.785%2B6abdba4.zip>

**2. The mod** — unzip `ZoominoesArchipelago.zip` into the same game folder. It drops
into `BepInEx/plugins/`.

**3. The world** — put `zoominoes.apworld` in your Archipelago install's
`custom_worlds/` folder.

On Linux the game runs under Proton with the same files. Add
`WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winhttp=n,b" %command%` to the Steam launch options, or the
loader will not inject.

## Playing

Press **F1** for the connection panel, enter your server address, port, slot name
and password, and connect. The panel opens by itself until you do. Details are
remembered for next launch.

Runs are played on a dedicated **AP** profile. Your existing saves are not read or
written while the mod is installed.

## What is randomised

Animals, snacks, souvenirs, zookeepers and difficulty tiers arrive as Archipelago
items, along with bonus gold, extra plays and hand size.

Checks come from Gift Shop slots and from finishing a day. **Every difficulty tier
has its own set of both** — "Tier 3 - Shop 2 - Slot 1" is a different location from
"Tier 5 - Shop 2 - Slot 1", so each tier you unlock opens 43 fresh checks: 24 across
its eight shops and 19 across its playable days. On top of that, winning with each
zookeeper and clearing each tier are checks in their own right.

Three goals: clear a target difficulty tier, clear it with several different
zookeepers, or collect Zoo Tickets scattered across the multiworld.

Only normal runs take part — daily challenges, seeded runs and challenge runs are
left alone.

Items apply from your **next** run, since the game fixes its content pool when a run
begins.

## Options

`Zoominoes-example.yaml` is ready to use — put it in your Archipelago `Players`
folder and change the name. `Zoominoes-template.yaml` is the full weighted template
with every option and its documentation.

Content the seed has no room for is unlocked from the start rather than left
unobtainable.

Only normal runs take part — daily challenges, seeded runs and challenge runs are
left alone.

Items apply from your **next** run, since the game fixes its content pool when a run
begins.

## Options

`Zoominoes-template.yaml` has every option, its documentation and its weights. Put it
in your Archipelago `Players` folder and change the name at the top.

Content the seed has no room for is unlocked from the start rather than left
unobtainable.
